variables.name: Fluxer bot token
variables.description: Bot token from your Fluxer instance (<application_id>.<secret>). Hidden from server users.

variables.name: Fluxer instance URL
variables.description: Base URL of your Fluxer instance, e.g. https://chat.example.org. The API is discovered from /.well-known/fluxer.

variables.name: API URL override
variables.description: Optional. Fluxer public API base (without /v1). Overrides discovery.

variables.name: Gateway URL override
variables.description: Optional. Fluxer gateway websocket URL. Overrides GET /v1/gateway/bot.

variables.name: GM role name
variables.description: Members with a role of this name (case-insensitive) can shuffle and set trump.

variables.name: Command prefix
variables.description: Prefix for bot commands, e.g. ! for !flip.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR or CRITICAL.

variables.name: Source URL
variables.description: Where users can get the bot's source code (AGPL-3.0 network-use offer). Shown in !help. Set this to your fork if you modify the bot.

variables.name: Rules file override
variables.description: Optional. Path to a rules data file. Leave blank to use the rules file packaged in the image.
